title: Health Potions
html:
Health Potions

Health potions restore a portion of your health over a certain length of time. There are three types of health potions.

  • Health Potion of the Daring Noobosaur
    • Replenish 45% health over 5 seconds.
    • Limited to a single stack of 20.
    • These potions cannot be replaced - no merchant sells them, nor do monsters drop them.
    • Usable by all player types.
  • Minor Health Potions
    • Replenish 40% health over 5 seconds.
    • Each stack holds up to 5 potions.
    • Players may have an unlimited number of stacks.
    • Can be obtained from monster drops. Also sold by Audrey the Alchemist and Samford the Hermit.
    • Usable by all player types.
  • Major Health Potions
    • Replenish 50% health over 5 seconds
    • Stackable up to 10 potions.
    • Players may have an unlimited number of stacks.
    • Can be obtained from monster drops. Also sold by Audrey the Alchemist and Samford the Hermit.
    • Usable only by Members. Free players cannot make use of these potions; they will drop, stack and can be sold, but cannot be used.

On the game interface, the health potion slot that appears to the left of the skill bar, will use potions in the order listed above (assuming all three types of potion are in inventory). This means that Noobasaur potions cannot be saved for later use unless placed into the bank. Using potions through the inventory window gets around this issue, but is awkward.
